episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_100:
Victor... I’ve heard it’s about time for this
Kubfu to evolve.
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_200:
Doesn’t it become a Pokémon called, like,
Urshifu?
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_400:
We’ll finally be able to show off the results
of our training with Bea’s lot!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_500:
According to my psychic powers, Urshifu’s
strikes flow like a river, raining down
nonstop on opponents.
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_600:
Pfft! Unfortunately for you, that’s dead
wrong!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_700:
The master told me Urshifu loves going for a
one-hit KO with a single devastating blow.
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_800:
Nope! My information also came from the
master!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_150: Urshifu rains down one-hit KOs?! Impossible!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_200:
There’s Single Strike Style, which prefers
heavy, individual hits...
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_210:
and there’s Rapid Strike Style, which excels
at flowing multi-hits!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_220:
I see! I’m curious what form you’ll evolve
him into, Victor.
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_230:
Indeed! I must know, so that I may win our
future battles!
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_240:
I was gonna head to the academy to pick up
two types of scrolls. Kubfu needs one to
evolve.
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_250:
Would you two like to come watch him
evolve?
episode_event_get_kakejiku/4001_1001_270:
In that case, I’ll get a head start and meet
you there!
